text:
## Scope  
Applies to:
- All new customer account openings (mandatory)
- Periodic re-screening (high-risk customers quarterly, standard annually)
- Transaction monitoring (ongoing, automated)
- Suspicious activity assessment and reporting  
---
name: Chunk 3/23

raw_entities.name: Customer Account Opening Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for opening new customer accounts, applicable to all new account openings on a mandatory basis. The process encompasses identity verification, address verification, AML screening, and compliance checkpoint validation before account activation.
context: Applies to: All new customer account openings (mandatory)

raw_entities.name: Periodic Customer Re-screening Process
raw_entities.description: Recurring AML and compliance re-screening procedure applied to existing customers at defined intervals based on risk classification. High-risk customers are re-screened quarterly, while standard-risk customers are re-screened annually.
context: Periodic re-screening (high-risk customers quarterly, standard annually)

raw_entities.name: Transaction Monitoring Process
raw_entities.description: Continuous automated monitoring of customer transactions to detect suspicious activity patterns and potential money laundering indicators. This process operates on an ongoing basis across all monitored accounts.

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Assessment and Reporting Process
raw_entities.description: Procedure for assessing suspicious activity identified through transaction monitoring or customer screening, determining whether a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) must be filed with the relevant authority, and managing the reporting obligation.
context: Applies to: All new customer account openings (mandatory)

raw_entities.name: Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance control to verify the identity of new customers during account opening. This verification is a prerequisite for account activation and is part of the broader Know Your Customer obligation.

raw_entities.name: Address Verification
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance control to verify the residential or business address of new customers during account opening. Address verification is a core component of KYC requirements for all new accounts.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Screening
raw_entities.description: Mandatory AML control screening new and existing customers against sanctions lists and Politically Exposed Person (PEP) databases. Applied at account opening and during periodic re-screening cycles.
context: Periodic re-screening (high-risk customers quarterly, standard annually)

raw_entities.name: Ongoing Transaction Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Automated, continuous monitoring of customer transactions to identify suspicious patterns, high-value transfers, and potential money laundering activity. Operates on an ongoing basis across all customer accounts.

raw_entities.name: New Customer
raw_entities.description: Individual applying for or opening a new account with the bank. Subject to mandatory KYC verification, AML screening, and compliance checkpoints before account activation.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: Existing customer classified as high-risk based on risk assessment criteria. Subject to enhanced due diligence, quarterly re-screening, and more frequent transaction monitoring review.
context: Periodic re-screening (high-risk customers quarterly, standard annually)

raw_entities.name: Standard-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: Existing customer classified as standard-risk based on risk assessment criteria. Subject to annual re-screening and standard transaction monitoring procedures.
context: Periodic re-screening (high-risk customers quarterly, standard annually)

raw_entities.name: New Account
raw_entities.description: Customer account being opened for the first time. Must pass all mandatory compliance checkpoints including KYC verification, AML screening, and sanctions checks before activation.

raw_entities.name: New Account Opening Compliance Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory regulatory gate that must be passed before a new account can be activated. Verifies completion of KYC verification, AML screening, sanctions checks, and all required due diligence documentation.

raw_entities.name: Periodic Re-screening Compliance Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory regulatory gate for periodic customer re-screening. Verifies that high-risk customers are re-screened quarterly and standard-risk customers annually against current sanctions and PEP lists.
context: Periodic re-screening (high-risk customers quarterly, standard annually)
